secrets.name: Inside the Shade
secrets.text: The inside of the lamp: a long room of green glass, warm as an afternoon, hung with the pull chains. Somebody lives up here, where it is never dark.

meta.label: The Reading Lamp
meta.blurb: Someone left the lamp on. It is the only light for a long way, and it falls on a single page the size of a field. You cannot read it from down here.
